digest.component_or_area: rebar project lifecycle policies and verification gates
propositions: Rebar project must enable both material-pin and close-review enforcement policies via configuration while library defaults remain false
Public lifecycle test suite must demonstrate invalidation propagation only after actual narrow material changes and unchanged re-reviews produce no downstream propagation
Outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks references must normalize to canonical prerequisite pins without duplication
Configuration keys must already exist in VerifyConfig and golden schema; this story verifies both are present together and enables them in rebar.toml only without re-registering keys
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new commands, list-output changes, or stored relation migrations must be introduced

Real CLI execution with no dry-run bypass must prove four gate-health cases: legacy unpinned attestation claim succeeds, current-pinned close succeeds, stale-pin drift rejects with proper exit code and reason, and missing close-plan review rejects with proper instruction
